title: SpecLive product-requirements discovery (self-referential)
notes: Self-referential: ground truth is verifiable from this repo's README/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS. Evidence turn_index is 0-based into transcript.turns; quotes are verbatim substrings.

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Derive candidate requirements from the live conversation in real time, each traceable to transcript evidence.

evidence.quote: derive candidate requirements in real time

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Each artifact records source evidence, rationale, confidence, derivation method, and validation state.

evidence.quote: record its source evidence, an interpretation rationale, a confidence score, the derivation method, and a validation state

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: A model-inferred requirement is never marked customer-confirmed without explicit human action.

evidence.quote: must never be marked customer-confirmed without an explicit human action

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: A recorded file can be uploaded and run through the same pipeline as the live mic.

evidence.quote: upload a recorded file and run it through the exact same pipeline

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Ingest live microphone audio over a streaming connection as the main path.

evidence.quote: Live microphone over a streaming connection is the main path

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Customer answers spawn conversation branches, each keeping its own evidence and derived artifacts.

evidence.quote: each branch has to keep its own evidence and derived artifacts

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Export a structured discovery package as JSON and Markdown.

evidence.quote: export a structured discovery package as JSON and Markdown

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: The facilitator follows a configurable discovery script.
The facilitator must be able to see why each requirement was proposed, or they won't trust it.

evidence.quote: If I can't see why the tool proposed a requirement, I won't trust it

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Speech-to-text must be provider-neutral (mock / local / hosted vendor).
Provider credentials stay server-side and never reach the browser.

evidence.quote: the provider credentials must stay server-side, never in the browser

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: The system runs with no API keys at all by default.

evidence.quote: it has to run with no API keys at all by default
